backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260512-004 policy semantics.
decision_rationale: The near-perfect Space trend TQS bucket improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion should stay default-off metadata/helper only because Space live slots remain zero.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe; any accepted change must remain default-off metadata until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: top up only official Space trend_long candidates with 0.95 <= existing trade_quality_score < 1.0.

2_history_check.exp-20260511-109: Rejected PL/BKSY data-vendor trend risk as a ticker bucket.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-115: Accepted official Space basket-positive risk scalar.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-004: Accepted perfect/capped TQS 1.5x risk top-up; this tests the adjacent uncapped trend-only quality bucket, not the same bucket.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-005: Rejected perfect-TQS target widening; this keeps targets fixed and changes only risk allocation.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_near_perfect_tqs_trend_risk_scalar; candidate pool, accepted Space risk scalars, targets, stops, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, and nonzero adjusted signals.
gate_questions.5_reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-20260512-004 Space stack, and each near-perfect TQS trend scalar across the canonical augmented snapshots.

hypothesis: After exp-20260512-004 showed capped Space TQS supports more risk, near-perfect but uncapped Space trend signals may be the adjacent quality bucket with enough lifecycle strength to justify a smaller bounded risk top-up.
interpretation: The near-perfect Space trend TQS bucket improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion should stay default-off metadata/helper only because Space live slots remain zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data remains below the closed-decision gate; this run uses an existing deterministic quality-score field.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby near-perfect Space TQS risk buckets on the same frozen snapshots. Future Space work should use forward event replacement value or a genuinely new catalyst-quality field.
single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for official Space trend_long signals with 0.95 <= trade_quality_score < 1.0
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking and event-bucket scoring are still sample-limited; mature satcom breadth, theme ETF timing, one-slot capacity, breakout geometry, data-vendor trend targets, perfect-TQS target broadening, and lunar/manufacturing target broadening already failed.
